Trying to see the data

```{python}
restricted = food_base[['product_name', 'generic_name', 'quantity', 'serving_size', 'trans-fat_100g', 'cholesterol_100g', 'carbohydrates_100g', 'sugars_100g', 'fiber_100g', 'proteins_100g', 'caffeine_100g', 'energy_100g']]
```

```{python}
clean_1 = restricted[restricted['product_name'].notna()]
```

```{python}
clean_2 = clean_1.drop(columns = ['generic_name', 'quantity'])
```

```{python}
clean_3 = clean_2[clean_2['product_name'] != ""]
clean_4 = clean_3[clean_3['product_name'] != "#Error!"]
clean_4['calories_100g'] = clean_4['energy_100g'] / 4.184
clean_5 = clean_4.drop(columns = ['energy_100g'])
clean_6 = clean_5.dropna(subset=['calories_100g'])
```

```{python}
import re

def is_latin(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return False
    # Remove non-letter characters (numbers, punctuation, spaces), then check remaining chars are latin
    letters_only = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z]', '', text)
    return len(letters_only) > 0

clean_7 = clean_6[clean_6['product_name'].apply(is_latin)]
clean_8 = clean_7.drop(columns = "caffeine_100g")
```

```{python}
clean_8.to_csv('clean_data.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)
```

```{python}
 clean_8.to_json('clean_data.json', orient='records', indent=4)
```
